title: Transition-graph-aligned failed-candidate deprecation
failure_signature: A failed-candidate cleanup method assumed candidate-to-superseded was legal, but the append-only runner correctly rejected that transition.
trigger_preconditions: candidate method has a failed witness
candidate_workaround: Retain the failed witness and rejection, move each failed candidate to deprecated as the transition graph permits, and name the preferred replacement in the transition note without rewriting history.
recurrence_guard: Read the current-state transition graph before mutation and require every failed candidate to end in an allowed terminal state.
rollback: If a deprecated method later needs reconsideration, create a new candidate with explicit lineage; never reopen or rewrite the terminal record.
scope_boundary: Method-state hygiene only; deprecation preserves failure and does not broaden the preferred transport's evidence scope.
